text: Jim, the yoga novice, had intended to join a beginner’s flow, but a misread schedule led him straight into an advanced vinyasa class. As he attempted to mimic the instructor’s graceful transitions, Jim’s body seemed to have other plans. He twisted into a pretzel-like shape, emitting a loud, resonant grunt that echoed off the studio walls. Just as he tried to hold a difficult balance pose, a sudden, unexpected toot escaped, shattering the room’s zen-like silence. The other students, trying desperately to maintain their composure, ended up giggling behind their hands, turning the serene session into a hilarious comedy of errors. Amidst the chaos, Jim looked around, confused, until he noticed a tall, slender figure in the corner of the room—a giraffe, known for its long neck, who had somehow wandered in and was watching the scene with amused detachment.
